_comment: mrABSURDLY standard voice (chosen by Adrian on 2026-11-06 = test variant C, voice-lab/2026-11-06_mrabsurdly-voice/). Same ElevenLabs request as john_shorts_fast (unchanged), plus a local tempo of x1.10 (Rubber Band R3, formants kept, pitch unchanged). Then ALWAYS: .venv/bin/python scripts/voice/shorts_master.py <short> --take=<take> --spoken=<file> --max-pause=0.18  (0.18 s after the speed-up = 0.20 s before it, exactly as in variant C).

elevenlabs._voice_id_note: Found 2026-11-05 via GET /v2/voices?search=John (exactly one match among 27 voices) and confirmed with GET /v1/voices/OEHTkiHZj6OczWZHu0Aj: HTTP 200, category 'professional' (PVC), status 'copied', no verification needed, notice period 730 days.
elevenlabs._model_note: John is fine-tuned for eleven_v4 (and multilingual_v2, turbo/flash), not for eleven_v3. Same model as the Buster test for a fair comparison.
elevenlabs._voice_settings_note: Stability 0.2 (previous test 0.35, John's default 0.50): even more expressive. Speed cannot be set in Eleven v4; the spoken file starts with the delivery instruction [energetic, fast-paced].
elevenlabs._cost_note: credits_per_char_estimate 1.0 is a safe upper bound for the free preview; measured on Mary Celeste: ~0.44 credits per character.

postprocess._note: Tempo x1.10 with Rubber Band (R3, formants kept), pitch 0, no EQ or loudness here: the clarity/loudness chain and the pause shortening happen in shorts_master.py (--max-pause=0.18).
